source.title: Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands

notes.saves: +1 status bonus to all saves vs. magic effects, +2 status bonus to all saves vs. mental effects

spells.name: Dancing Lights
spells.text: You create up to four floating lights, no two of which are more than 10 feet apart. Each sheds light like a torch. When you Sustain the Spell, you can move any number of lights up to 60 feet. Each light must remain within 120 feet of you and within 10 feet of all others, or it winks out.

items.name: Rejuvenation
items.text:
When a graveknight is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of 1d10 days-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with Disintegrate), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

items.name: Sacrilegious Aura
items.text: 30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a counteract modifier of +24.

items.name: Status Bonus to Saves
items.text:
+1 status bonus to all saves vs. magic effects.

+2 status bonus to all saves vs. mental effects.

items.name: Devastating Blast
items.text:
The graveknight unleashes a 30-foot cone of energy. Creatures in the area take 8d12 cold damage (DC 36 basic Reflex save save).

The graveknight can use this ability once every 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Graveknight's Curse
items.text:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour.

Saving Throw DC 36 Will save save

---

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 Doomed 1 and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 Doomed 2, the creature's Speed is reduced by 10, and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight.

Effect: Graveknight's Curse

items.name: Heart-Seeking Strike
items.text: The Shraen graveknight Steps once then Strikes with its rapier. A creature damaged by the attack must attempt a DC 36 Fortitude save save. On a failure, the creature takes 4d6 bleed. On a critical failure, the attack pierces the creature's heart, and the creature dies.

items.name: Quick Draw
items.text: The Shraen graveknight draws a weapon, then Strikes with it.

items.name: Ruinous Weapons
items.text:
At the time of its creation, a graveknight chooses one of the following energy types that was relevant to its life or death: acid, cold, electricity, or fire.

Any weapon the graveknight wields gains the effects of the caustic, frost, shock, or flaming weapon rune, respectively, in addition to a +1 striking weapon rune.

If the graveknight is 14th level or higher, its weapons instead gain the effects of the greater versions of both of these runes.

items.name: Weapon Master
items.text: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.
